name: ANIME
style: a hand-painted Japanese anime film scene, keeping the real buildings, signs and text, objects and camera angle. Painterly brushwork. Every person is carefully drawn as an anime character in the same style: clean line art, simple anime eyes, natural proportions, soft cel shading, real hair, clothes, pose and expression.

variants.day: Deep blue sky with tall glowing summer clouds, warm sunlight.
variants.sunset: Orange and pink sunset sky, golden backlight, street lights on.
variants.night: Starry night sky, warm shop and street lights, deep blue shadows.
